mission: MVP vendible hoy para contexto electoral español, con inteligencia electoral reproducible, neutral, fail-closed y sin falsas certificaciones.
queen_directive: Coordinar agentes especializados como un sistema de automatización jerárquico; un agente maestro debe mantener un único estado de verdad y asignar cada tarea una sola vez.
Antes de modificar: inspeccionar estado actual. Después: codificar, ejecutar, evidenciar y checkpoint.
Nunca declarar PASS, verde, certificado, desplegado u operativo sin evidencia observable.
Nunca duplicar motores, pipelines, fuentes de verdad, modelos o artefactos.
Si dos agentes trabajan sobre la misma superficie, uno debe quedar bloqueado hasta reconciliación.
Telegram queda reservado al agente concurrente actual; no tocarlo hasta recibir su checkpoint final.

truth.policy: absence of external audit does not block non-official demo

data_rules: Official sources first: Interior/JEC/BOE; then CIS/INE and explicitly labeled secondary sources.
Current survey data may be demo/secondary-reconciled; official claims require PRIMARY_VERIFIED.
Do not convert national polling into observed territorial polling.
Do not fabricate field dates, sample sizes, methodology, URLs, hashes or territorial observations.
Every promoted result requires provenance and reproducibility.
next_queue: 1. Observe or otherwise obtain genuine GitHub Actions execution evidence for mvp-validation.
2. Fix every CI failure until green, preserving fail-closed semantics.
3. Materialize and verify normalized current survey artifact.
4. Verify Render configuration/deployment only with observable evidence.
5. Verify current territorial evidence and distinguish observed vs modelled.
6. Verify full non-Telegram E2E: current survey→vote composition→territorial input→D'Hondt→dashboard/API.
7. Reconcile with the other agent's Telegram checkpoint; only then integrate Telegram.
8. Run complete regression suite and certification gates.
9. Produce final product release evidence; never label official certification unless external audit exists.
known_blockers: Current 2026 general territorial matrix for 52 constituencies is not yet established as complete primary observed evidence.
2026 territorial prediction is modelled and must remain explicitly non-official unless its calibration/evidence contract is satisfied.
New MVP workflow had no visible workflow-run evidence at last inspection.
Render and SMTP are configuration-level until actual deployment/send verification.
resume_point: Resume at mvp-validation execution evidence, not by recreating dashboard/newsletter/data work.
quality_gate: No duplication, no contradiction, no invented evidence, fail-closed, checkpoint every meaningful state transition.
